fixed.explanation: _trySerialize returns the raw value as `trivial`, and callers test `if (trivial)`, so falsy values and keys (0, false, '', null) are dropped. Restore uses `??`, which treats null as missing. Infinity, NaN and -0 are classed as trivial numbers, so JSON turns them into null. The fix adds an explicit isTrivial flag, makes only finite non-negative-zero numbers trivial, and restores with `!== undefined`.

input.intent: Code that serializes IndexedDB databases, object stores, records and keys into storage state (and restores them), using truthiness checks that drop falsy keys/values and JSON that turns Infinity into null. Needs exact serialization/deserialization of keys and values.
input.symptom: Saving storage state with IndexedDB drops falsy values/keys (0, false, empty string, null) and converts Infinity to null.
